::: {.utility-flow}
::: {.utility-step}
**Search for a concept**

Start with terms like heritability, BLUP, selection or genomic matrix.
:::

::: {.utility-step}
**Open context**

Use the results to enter the module or section where the concept is applied.
:::

::: {.utility-step}
**Get back on track**

After the consultation, resume the sequence of modules or the weekly roadmap.
:::
:::

::: {.utility-decision role="region" aria-label="How to decide what to do with a search result"}
::: {.utility-decision-copy}
**After the result, choose an action**

The search must end in a simple decision: open the module that explains the concept, compare the term in the glossary or return to the script to maintain the sequence.
:::

::: {.utility-decision-grid role="list" aria-label="Actions after searching the course"}
::: {.utility-decision-item role="listitem"}
**New concept**

Open the full module before trying to interpret the output in R.
:::

::: {.utility-decision-item role="listitem"}
**Isolated term**

Consult the glossary and then return to the module excerpt.
:::

::: {.utility-decision-item role="listitem"}
**Quick review**

Use the result to return to the right phase of the trail.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.utility-evidence-route role="navigation" aria-label="How to turn the query into technical evidence"}
::: {.utility-evidence-route-copy}
**From consultation to evidence**

The search only resolves the session when it returns you to a technical page. Choose the format you need to review before proceeding.
:::

::: {.utility-evidence-route-grid role="list" aria-label="Evidence routes after search"}
::: {.utility-evidence-route-item role="listitem"}
**Code**

Use when result points to script, simulation, or parameter.

[Open M01](modules/modulo01-introducao-ao-melhoramento-animal.qmd){.entry-link aria-label="Open Module 01 to review code evidence after search"}
:::

::: {.utility-evidence-route-item role="listitem"}
**Table**

Use when the result requires comparison of parameters, variances or correlations.

[Open M06](modules/modulo06-correlacoes-geneticas-e-fenotipicas.qmd){.entry-link aria-label="Open Module 06 to review table evidence after search"}
:::

::: {.utility-evidence-route-item role="listitem"}
**Figure**

Use when the result involves visual pattern, SNPs, GWAS or prediction.

[Open M12](modules/modulo12-matrizes-genomicas-gwas-e-predicao-genomica.qmd){.entry-link aria-label="Open Module 12 to review visual evidence after search"}
:::
:::
:::

::: {.utility-examples role="region" aria-label="Useful search examples"}
::: {.utility-examples-copy}
**Start with a small search**

Short terms help you find context faster. After opening a result, return to the module, roadmap, or glossary with a defined question.
:::

::: {.utility-examples-grid role="list" aria-label="Recommended search types"}
::: {.utility-examples-item role="listitem"}
**Parameter**

heritability, repeatability, genetic correlation.
:::

::: {.utility-examples-item role="listitem"}
**Method**

BLUP, GWAS, genomic array, quality control.
:::

::: {.utility-examples-item role="listitem"}
**Action in R**

simulation, variance, regression, prediction.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.utility-query-plan role="region" aria-label="How to prepare a useful search"}
::: {.utility-query-plan-copy}
**Prepare the search as a question**

Before searching, transform the question into a keyword and a context. This avoids opening too many results and helps you get back to the right module.
:::

::: {.utility-query-plan-grid role="list" aria-label="Plan to search the course"}
::: {.utility-query-plan-item role="listitem"}
**Term**

Use a short keyword: heritability, BLUP, SNP.
:::

::: {.utility-query-plan-item role="listitem"}
**Context**

Search next to the phase: data, model or genomics.
:::

::: {.utility-query-plan-item role="listitem"}
**Return**

Open the result and return to the module with a defined action.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.utility-no-result role="region" aria-label="What to do when search does not solve it"}
::: {.utility-no-result-copy}
**If the search doesn't solve the problem, reduce the question**

Too few results or too broad results indicate that the question needs to be returned to a phase, module, or shorter term.
:::

::: {.utility-no-result-grid role="list" aria-label="Adjustments when search fails"}
::: {.utility-no-result-item role="listitem"}
**Reduce**

Use a technical word instead of a long sentence.

[See examples](#useful-search-examples){.entry-link aria-label="See useful search examples"}
:::

::: {.utility-no-result-item role="listitem"}
**Anchor**

Include likely phase or module to retrieve context.

[View modules](modules/index.qmd){.entry-link aria-label="View the module index"}
:::

::: {.utility-no-result-item role="listitem"}
**Resume**

Go back to the script if you are unsure about the sequence.

[See roadmap](semanas/index.qmd){.entry-link aria-label="View the weekly roadmap"}
:::
:::
:::

::: {.utility-result-close role="region" aria-label="How to close a useful search"}
::: {.utility-result-close-copy}
**Close the search with defined destination**

Once you find a result, don't keep opening pages in a row. Choose whether the search resolved definition, context or resume.
:::

::: {.utility-result-close-grid role="list" aria-label="Destinations after a useful search"}
::: {.utility-result-close-item role="listitem"}
**Definition**

Save the term and return to the original excerpt.

[Open glossary](glossary.qmd){.entry-link aria-label="Open technical glossary"}
:::

::: {.utility-result-close-item role="listitem"}
**Context**

Open the module when the answer requires full reading.

[View modules](modules/index.qmd){.entry-link aria-label="View the module index after search"}
:::

::: {.utility-result-close-item role="listitem"}
**Resumption**

Go back to the script if the question was about order.

[See roadmap](semanas/index.qmd){.entry-link aria-label="View the weekly roadmap after search"}
:::
:::
:::

<script>
window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
if (typeof PagefindUI === 'undefined') {
document.getElementById('search').innerHTML =
'<p>Search is activated after the published rendering of the site.</p>';
return;
  }

new PagefindUI({
element: '#search',
showSubResults: true,
showImages: false,
translations: {
placeholder: 'Search in course',
clear_search: 'Clear',
load_more: 'Load more results',
search_label: 'Search this site',
filters_label: 'Filters',
zero_results: 'No results for [SEARCH_TERM]',
many_results: '[COUNT] results for [SEARCH_TERM]',
one_result: '[COUNT] result for [SEARCH_TERM]',
searching: 'Searching for [SEARCH_TERM]...'
    }
  });
});
</script>
